question_text: A school replaced all of their light bulbs with a new type of light bulb. The new light bulbs use less energy. How will the new light bulbs most likely help the environment?
choices: A: The amount of light pollution will decrease.

C: Fewer natural resources will be used to make electricity.
D: Money will be saved on the electricity bill for the school.
